links.outcome: Agreement of automatic callosal angle with manual method in pre- and postoperative scans with shunt artifacts
links.effect: Automatic CA correlated excellently with the traditional manual method: preoperative ICC = 0.92; postoperative ICC = 0.96, indicating robustness to shunt-related artifacts.
links.quote: Automatic CA measurements showed excellent correlation with the traditional method, preoperative ICC = 0.92; postoperative ICC = 0.96.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and robustness of an automated AI measurement tool (cMRI) against multiple manual measurement methods on brain MRI scans.
